tasks.answer: Use the feature-level DeleteDiscussion (destructive confirmation control wrapping the shared ConfirmationDialog with danger icon/trigger); it requires the discussion id and is admin-gated. If composing from scratch instead, the generic ui.dialog.confirmation-dialog.ConfirmationDialog needs triggerButton, confirmButton and title.

LoginForm uses ui.form.Input (text input rendering label/error via FieldWrapper). It binds react-hook-form through the required registration prop, e.g. registration={register('email')}, used inside <Form>.
DiscussionsList uses ui.table.TablePagination; table pagination needs totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl (it derives page links from the root URL).
MDPreview safely renders Markdown; the Markdown text is passed in the required value prop.
CreateDiscussion is an admin-only drawer form (title + Markdown body). It requires the Authorization provider; only admins see the trigger, so it must render inside an authenticated/admin route.

notes: Every task began with one brief search (--limit 10 --brief); the brief view supplied id/importPath/layer/requiredProps outright, so tasks 3 and 4 needed no get. One get was used only where the brief lacked summary/constraints: task 1 (disambiguating shared ConfirmationDialog vs feature DeleteDiscussion), task 2 (how Input binds react-hook-form), task 5 (which permission). No --include props, no repeated IDs, no synonym re-searches. 8 calls total = 5 brief searches + 3 gets. No project source read; the only file touched was a 600-byte head of component-catalog.config.json to locate the CLI config, and component-catalog.json was never opened.
